subject: Mimic
picture: A mimic in a dungeon treasure room. It is a wooden treasure chest that is alive. The lid is a wide mouth with large simple teeth and a thick tongue. Two hidden eyes on the chest front. Four stubby feet under the box. A few large plain coins on the floor. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
